meta.name: Ensure AWS Managed IAMFullAccess IAM policy is not used.
meta.description: Ensure AWS Managed IAMFullAccess IAM policy is not used.
meta.remediation: Replace arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess with a customer managed policy that grants only the IAM actions the principal needs.

evaluators.description: No data.aws_iam_policy resolves the managed policy named IAMFullAccess. error_tolerance 2 skips a policy whose name is unknown at plan time (name_prefix) rather than failing it.

aws_iam_policy_attachment.policy_arn must not be the AWS managed IAMFullAccess policy; NotContainedIn with a list also passes an explicit null, and tolerance 2 skips an ARN that is unknown at plan time

aws_iam_user_policy_attachment.policy_arn must not be the AWS managed IAMFullAccess policy; NotContainedIn with a list also passes an explicit null, and tolerance 2 skips an ARN that is unknown at plan time

aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.policy_arn must not be the AWS managed IAMFullAccess policy; NotContainedIn with a list also passes an explicit null, and tolerance 2 skips an ARN that is unknown at plan time

aws_iam_group_policy_attachment.policy_arn must not be the AWS managed IAMFullAccess policy; NotContainedIn with a list also passes an explicit null, and tolerance 2 skips an ARN that is unknown at plan time
aws_ssoadmin_managed_policy_attachment.managed_policy_arn must not be the AWS managed IAMFullAccess policy

eval_expression: iam_policy_name_not_iamfullaccess && policy_attachment_arn && user_policy_attachment_arn && role_policy_attachment_arn && group_policy_attachment_arn && ssoadmin_managed_policy_arn
